properties.title: Force tides: tidal mixing dominates here
properties.message: This region is a maze of shallow basins and narrow straits where tidal mixing dominates, amplified by resonance in the passages. Models without tides make up for it by raising local mixing; with tides, the model mixes where it really happens.
properties.instruction: Give configure_forcings the TPXO files and the tidal constituents M2, S2, K1 and O1: tides here are semidiurnal, diurnal or mixed, so force both kinds. Check tidal phase and amplitude against the region's tide gauges.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: the region consists of many small, shallow, and interconnected basins with narrow straits, where intense tidal mixing plays a dominant role.
